concept: RDS Multi-AZ: synchronous standby and automatic failover
tests: Multi-AZ vs read replicas for relational DB high availability.
expected: RDS Multi-AZ — synchronous replication to a standby in another AZ, automatic failover. Triggers: "automatic failover", "standby in another AZ", "synchronous replication".
why_not: Read replica — asynchronous, for read scaling; Single-AZ — no standby; MySQL on a single EC2 — no built-in HA.
